PHYSICS — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Floating and Sinking? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Floating and Sinking.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Floating and Sinking.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Floating and Sinking.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Floating and Sinking.

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transistors? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transistors.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Transistors.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transistors.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transistors.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

6. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Quantity of Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Quantity of Heat.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Quantity of Heat.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Quantity of Heat.

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

12. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

13. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Thin lenses? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Thin lenses.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Thin lenses.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Thin lenses.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thin lenses.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Photoelectric effect? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Photoelectric effect.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Photoelectric effect.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Photoelectric effect.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mains electricity? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Mains electricity.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mains electricity.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mains electricity.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mains electricity.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Circular motion? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Circular motion.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Circular motion.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Circular motion.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Circular motion.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electromagnetic induction? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electromagnetic induction.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electromagnetic induction.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electromagnetic induction.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electromagnetic induction.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dynamics? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dynamics.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Dynamics.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dynamics.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dynamics.

21. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
22. In three clear sentences, explain Transistors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Dynamics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Circular motion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Floating and Sinking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Quantity of Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Thin lenses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
